title: Show three measurements of each point at once
description: A 3-D scatterplot places points by three numeric fields in a box seen from an angle, so the reader sees how groups separate along all three.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]

## One species separates along two measurements

These illustrative measurements give each penguin a bill length, a bill depth and a flipper length. Nearer dots are larger and more opaque, and each dot stands on a faint line to the floor. The default view looks from 35 degrees round and 28 degrees above; `style.azimuth` and `style.elevation` change it.

title: Gentoo penguins stand apart in bill depth and flipper length
